UPDATE products
SET embedding = $1::vector
WHERE product_name = '{{ $json.product_name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
RETURNING
    id,
    product_name,
    brand,

    embedding IS NOT NULL AS has_embedding
FROM products;
